assessment.security_status_cs: Brazílie prožívá vyostřené prezidentské volby s těsným soubojem mezi stávajícím prezidentem Luizem Ináciem Lulou da Silvou a Fláviem Bolsonarem, což vyvolává silnou společenskou polarizaci. V Argentině mezitím pokračují politické střety a korupční kauzy kolem vysoce postavených politiků, zatímco globální komoditní trhy reagují na napětí v obchodu s kávou a ropou.
assessment.security_status_en: Brazil is experiencing a fiercely contested presidential runoff between incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, driving intense social polarization. Meanwhile, Argentina faces ongoing political clashes and high-profile corruption trials, as global commodity markets react to tensions in coffee and oil trade.

recommendations.reason_cs: Extrémně těsný výsledek prezidentského souboje mezi Lulou a Fláviem Bolsonarem vyvolává na trzích vysokou nervozitu a volatilitu. Doporučujeme vyčkat na oficiální potvrzení výsledků a směřování hospodářské politiky příští administrativy.
recommendations.reason_en: The extremely tight presidential race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro is driving high market nervousness and volatility. We recommend waiting for official election results and clarity on the next administration's economic policy.

recommendations.reason_cs: Trhy nadále sledují politickou polarizaci a blížící se volební cykly spolu s právními kauzami a diplomatickým napětím ohledně Falkland/Malvín. Doporučujeme opatrnost a udržování stávajících pozic bez navyšování rizika.
recommendations.reason_en: Markets continue to monitor political polarization and approaching electoral cycles alongside legal cases and diplomatic tensions over the Falklands/Malvinas. We advise caution and maintaining existing positions without increasing risk exposure.

recommendations.reason_en: Global demand for industrial metals and lithium remains solid, supporting the fundamentals of regional mining companies despite political noise. Prices remain attractive for building positions gradually.

recommendations.reason_en: Prices of key commodities including coffee and soy are reacting to fluctuating trade policies and tariff threats. We recommend waiting for negotiation outcomes and price stabilization.

recommendations.reason_en: Developments in South America have only an indirect impact on Czech domestic stocks through global sentiment and commodity trends. These equities remain primarily driven by European macroeconomic factors.

assessment.forecast_cs: V nejbližších hodinách budou trhy plně vstřebávat výsledky brazilského prezidentského run-offu, což určí krátkodobý trend pro regionální měny a akcie. Zvýšená volatilita a opatrnost investorů přetrvají minimálně do ustálení politické situace.
assessment.forecast_en: In the coming hours, markets will fully absorb the results of the Brazilian presidential runoff, setting the short-term trend for regional currencies and equities. Heightened volatility and investor caution will persist at least until the political situation stabilizes.
assessment.forecast_review_cs: Předchozí předpověď se potvrdila, neboť trhy skutečně plně absorbovaly výsledky brazilského run-offu a čelí zvýšené volatilitě.
assessment.forecast_review_en: The previous forecast was confirmed as markets fully absorbed the results of the Brazilian runoff and faced elevated volatility.

articles.title: ‘We can’t let the far right take power again’: Lula voters in final push before Brazil runoff
articles.summary:
In bellwether Minais Gerais, with polls about even, president’s supporters are striving to win over those who abstained or voted for Flavio Bolsonaro

Naiara Boroni, Nikolas Domingues and Jodersson Diego live in the same city and do not know one another, but said they had done the same thing in recent days: persuaded at least one person who had not voted for the leftist president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the first round to choose him in this Sunday’s runoff.

In Boroni’s case, it was her grandmother who had not turned out; in Domingues’s, a cousin who had chosen a candidate who finished fourth. But Diego achieved what to many sounds almost impossible in such a polarised country: he said he had persuaded a woman who voted for the far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro to switch sides.

articles.summary:
Jorge Luis Zambrano, alias “Rasquiña”

Jorge Luis Zambrano, alias “Rasquiña” or “JL,” was the charismatic leader of the Choneros, which, for years, was Ecuador’s most enterprising and powerful criminal group. Rasquiña oversaw the group’s transformation from a localized criminal group into a nationwide prison-based criminal federation with links to transnational drug-trafficking organizations. He was assassinated in 2020.
